In the matter between Anjuman Moinut Tulba Through Its Chairman & ...Petitioners Ors Versus Education Officer Primary & Ors ...Respondents With Writ Petition No. 938 Of 2023 Alpa Utpanna Ghatt Mahila Ghruh Udyog ...Petitioners Sahakari Udyogig Utpadan Sanstha Ltd & Ors Versus Municipal Commissioner, Malegaon Municipal ...Respondents Corporation & Ors Alpa Utpanna Ghatt Mahila Ghruh Udyog ... vs Anjuman Moinut Tulba Thr Its Chairman ... on 8 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82527750/ 1 Page 1 of 7 8th February 2023 ::: Uploaded on - 09/02/2023 ::: Downloaded on - 09/02/2023 22:26: 905.Aswp-9556-2022.Doc Mr Nr Bubna, for the Petitioners in Wp/9556/2022. Mr Mukesh Vashi, Senior Advocate, with Jaynil Vasi, Manisha Desai i/b. Mp Vashi & Associates, for the Petitioner in Wp/938/2023. The Writ Petitioner in Writ Petition No. 938 of 2023, Alpa Utpanna Ghatt Mahila Ghruh Udyog Sahakari Udyogig Utpadan Sanstha Ltd ("Mahila Udyog Sanstha") is the intervenor in Writ Petition No. 9556 of 2022.
texts.facts: The Writ Petitioner in Writ Petition No. 938 of 2023, Alpa Utpanna Ghatt Mahila Ghruh Udyog Sahakari Udyogig Utpadan Sanstha Ltd ("Mahila Udyog Sanstha") is the intervenor in Writ Petition No. 9556 of 2022. In Writ Petition No. 9556 of 2022 there are as many as 40 Petitioners. Some of them are Minority Trusts. These Trusts run one or more of the Petitioner Schools. There is a complicated description of which trust runs what school in paragraph 1. 2.
texts.arguments: (b) For a writ of mandamus, for a writ in nature of 8th February 2023 905.ASWP-9556-2022.DOC mandamus and/or for any other appropriate writ, direction or order directing the Respondents not to force them to accept services of contractor appointed by them for supply of Mid-Day Meal contrary to government policy and guidelines."
